S3 is failing fast, so this is an external outage and not a timeout. The auth-svc and IdP timeouts affect /login and are a separate red herring. The metrics-agent errors are noise.
The IdP timeouts are real, but they only affect the /login path and not /search.

verdict.recommendedAction: Check AWS status for S3 us-east-1. Add fallback or queueing for catalog-svc S3 writes, and make search-api degrade gracefully when catalog-svc fails. Investigate the IdP slowness separately. It is hurting /login.
